description.value: Goldie's Donuts & Bakery is a gourmet brioche donut shop that uses a 24-hour slow fermentation process imported from Korean baking tradition to produce exceptionally light and flavourful donuts. The Horseshoe Bay location in West Vancouver sits along a popular Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor, making it a natural pit stop for cyclists heading to or from Squamish. The shop also offers signature espresso drinks like Peanut Butter Cream Latte and Oreo Cream Mocha to pair with its donuts.
